item.title: MATCH OFF | Swansea City Women vs Wrexham AFC Women postponed
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women’s Genero Adran Premier fixture away to Swansea City has been postponed due to a waterlogged pitch at the Llandarcy Academy of Sport. The match, our first of Phase Two, was originally scheduled to take place today (Sunday February 15) at 2pm, but constant rain in South Wales has made the pitch unplayable. A new date will be announced in due course.

item.description: With the Genero Adran Trophy final fast approaching, Wrexham AFC Women Season Ticket holders are now able to secure free tickets and travel for the fixture at Bangor City Stadium on Sunday, February 22. item.title: FA CUP DRAW | Red Dragons to face Chelsea
item.description: Wrexham AFC will host Chelsea in the Fifth Round of the Emirates FA Cup. The Red Dragons beat fellow Championship side Ipswich Town in the Fourth Round, thanks to a 34th minute Josh Windass strike, which was enough to earn victory over The Tractor Boys and progress to the Fifth Round for the first time since 1997. item.title: U18 REPORT | Carlisle United 2-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s suffered a 2-1 defeat away to Carlisle United in the EFL Youth Alliance North. item.title: REPORT | Bristol City 2-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Ollie Rathbone scored his sixth goal of the season as Wrexham drew away to Bristol City at Ashton Gate. Rathbone gave Wrexham a deserved half-time lead, but the Robins shuffled their pack at the interval and hit back immediately through Sinclair Armstrong. Joe Williams put through his own net to give Wrexham the lead again, but Max Bird volleyed in a brilliant equaliser to snatch a point.
